method: Full 1977–2026 completeness NOT verified; a contemporary original 1995 diary transcribed in 2026 and historic 1999 photos are useful lower-confidence leads. Taronga plans and combined Sydney annual report are not confirmation of Dubbo arrival. 1996 NSW parliamentary answer and federal recovery plan confirm two historical conservation holdings.

summary.note: 89 researched historical entries, NOT a complete certified species census. Separated first-party holdings, 1995 retrospective diary, visitor photographs and unverified accession status.
